nodes.falsz.options.[przekonaj].text.t: It's worth it. A quartermaster who issues proofs does better than one who doesn't.

nodes.falsz.text.t: The quartermaster looks up from his chits. "Proof of life? Form forty-six, stamp in the left corner and the signature of a man who exists. I can do that. The question is whether you can convince me it's worth it."

nodes.falsz_ok.text.t: The quartermaster squints for a moment, then stamps it with a sigh of resignation. "For the security of the state. My own." He hands you a letter so official it could walk through the gate by itself.

nodes.falsz_pudlo.text.t: "Convincing, but not enough." The quartermaster shakes his head. "You won't fool me twice, I learn faster than you lie. If you need paper, try the temple. The sisters don't ask, they count."

nodes.kwit.options.[falsz].text.t: I need proof that I'm alive and saw something.

nodes.kwit.options.[potrzeby].text.t: What do the barracks need most?

nodes.kwit.options.[wino_kupione].text.t: I bought the wine for the barracks honestly.

nodes.kwit.options.[wino_nic].text.t: There'll be no wine. I told the soldiers why.

nodes.kwit.options.[wino_przemyt].text.t: The wine reached the barracks. Don't ask where from.

nodes.kwit.options.[zold].text.t: I heard the pay from the front never arrived.

nodes.kwit.text.t: The quartermaster sits behind a table sagging under chits, stamps and unsettled business. "Name? Orders? Seal? If you've got none of the three, you don't exist, so don't waste my time. If you have, wait in the queue that doesn't exist."

nodes.potrzeby.text.t: "Everything. Men, iron, blankets, cabbage and patience. Patience has the worst rate: the price goes up and the supply goes down." He coughs meaningfully. "If anyone knew where to get a few barrels of wine for the barracks, he could count on gratitude. Not money, gratitude."

nodes.wino_kupione.text.t: "Wine with a bill, a stamp and a signature. First time in two years that anything arrived the way it was meant to. I don't know what to do with it, so I entered it in three ledgers."

nodes.wino_nic.text.t: "There's no wine, but the men know why there's none, and that turns out to be worse. Before, it was me cursing, now everyone does." He shifts chits from the left pile to the right. "I'd rather be left alone with the debt."

nodes.wino_przemyt.text.t: "Wine? It arrived. I don't know from where and I've got it in no chit, so it doesn't exist." He stamps a blank sheet, on principle. "If anyone asks, it turned up by itself."

nodes.zold.text.t: "Pay from the front? First I've heard, and I'm always the last to hear anything. If it arrived, why did command send me a refund for the seal? And if it didn't, what's the seal for?"
